geometry_source: Existing EU5 calibrated geometry and already reviewed historical selectors. These rows preserve the existing mapped footprints but explicitly record where a rural-only capacity boundary or date-compatible upper estimate is missing.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Mamluk Egypt's Nile Delta, Nile Valley, western oases and Red Sea dependencies used by the existing lower-bound record. The selector covers the EU5 lower_egypt_area and upper_egypt_area, but it does not separate Cairo/Alexandria or other redistribution hubs from rural production.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for the broad EU5 envelope; low for a rural-only capacity boundary
crosswalks.resolution_method: Reuse the existing high-coverage selector only for a negative gate. Before any upper anchor promotion, construct an area-weighted rural boundary from the 1298/1315 cadastre that excludes Cairo/Alexandria and quantify imported/redistributed staple calories.
required_actions: separate rural Nile/Delta production from Cairo/Alexandria and other urban redistribution
find an independently derived food-balance upper interval, not a population reconstruction
document a saturation fraction or pressure interval for the same rural boundary
crosswalks.notes: Full polygon coverage does not close the semantic gap: the accepted lower-bound footprint is not yet a rural-only capacity footprint.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Mapungubwe National Park/UNESCO property plus buffer used by the 2021 South African settlement survey, not the wider transfrontier polity.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Retain exact containing-location crosswalk for the one-sided >=10,700 test. No upper capacity is assigned until an independent food/land ceiling is published for this same survey footprint and the drought/abandonment endpoint is separated.
required_actions: keep the existing 10,700 observation as lower-bound only
do not multiply the floor or use the wider political territory
seek an independent upper food-balance interval for the surveyed footprint
crosswalks.notes: The high crosswalk is sufficient for validation, not for promotion: the evidence is one-sided and terminally drought-shocked.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Approximately 2,000 ha ancient Engaruka field, canal and terraced settlement system between the Olemelepo and Engaruka river fans.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Use the existing exact candidate footprint for out-of-period physical validation. Do not project the completed 1620-1720 system capacity backward to 1337; a date-specific pre-1400 boundary/capacity record would be required for promotion.
required_actions: map any early-1400s construction phase separately from the later maximum system
find a 1337-compatible saturation interval before training use
crosswalks.notes: This is the strongest independent upper-capacity calculation found in the African review, but it fails the fixed date gate.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Entire 2,034 km2 island of Tenerife, partitioned into nine menceyatos and communal middle/high-mountain pasture.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Retain exact island crosswalk for the existing >=15,000 lower-bound test. Do not treat the 20,000 upper edge of the archaeological population interval as capacity_high without an independent food-balance ceiling and a shock-free saturation interval.
required_actions: seek an island-wide upper capacity calculation for the same pre-conquest boundary
crosswalks.notes: Exact geometry does not change population semantics: 20,000 is an observed interval high, not a Malthusian ceiling.
